name.fr-FR: Mélanges pour le Dauphin et plan d’un traité de théologie
name.en-US: Miscellanies for the Dauphin and Plan of a Treatise on Theology
name.pt-BR: Miscelâneas para o Delfim e plano de um tratado de teologia

description.fr-FR: Exercices et instructions de Bossuet pour le Dauphin : l’instruction pour sa première communion, les preuves de l’existence de Dieu par les créatures, l’exhortation à l’amour de la vertu (en français et en latin), des extraits de la Morale d’Aristote, des sentences choisies, une grammaire latine et les maximes de César ; en appendice, le Plan d’un traité de théologie. Édition Lachat (1865).
description.en-US: Exercises and instructions by Bossuet for the Dauphin: the instruction for his first communion, the proofs of God’s existence from creatures, the exhortation to the love of virtue (in French and Latin), extracts from Aristotle’s Ethics, selected sentences, a Latin grammar and the maxims of Caesar; with the Plan of a Treatise on Theology as an appendix. Lachat edition (1865).
description.pt-BR: Exercícios e instruções de Bossuet para o Delfim: a instrução para sua primeira comunhão, as provas da existência de Deus pelas criaturas, a exortação ao amor da virtude (em francês e em latim), extratos da Ética de Aristóteles, sentenças escolhidas, uma gramática latina e as máximas de César; em apêndice, o Plano de um tratado de teologia. Edição Lachat (1865).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXVI, pages 001-004, and volume III, page 015. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
